courses.title: 기초 회화
courses.desc_ko: 처음 만난 사람과 인사하고, 카페와 식당에서 주문하고, 길과 교통편을 묻는 기초 회화예요.

lessons.title: 인사하고 이름 말하기
lessons.goal_ko: 처음 만난 사람에게 인사하고 내 이름을 말할 수 있어요.

learn.en: Hi, my name is Jisoo.
learn.note_ko: 이름을 말하는 기본 표현이에요. 편한 자리에서는 'I'm Jisoo.'처럼 짧게 해도 돼요.

learn.en: You can call me Jay.
learn.note_ko: 영어 이름이나 줄인 이름으로 불러 달라고 할 때 써요.

learn.en: Nice to meet you, too.
learn.note_ko: 상대가 먼저 'Nice to meet you.'라고 하면 끝에 too를 붙여 답해요.

practice.en: Hi, my name is Jisoo.
You can call me Jay.
Nice to meet you, too.
Hi, my name is Daniel.
You can call me Sam.
My first name is Mina.
alts: My name is Mina.

practice.en: My last name is Park.
alts: My family name is Park.

practice.en: Hi, my name is Minho Kim.
Just call me by my nickname.
alts: You can call me by my nickname.

practice.en: Let me introduce myself first.
alts: I'll introduce myself first.

practice.en: Sorry, what's your name again?
alts: Sorry, what is your name again?
Sorry, what was your name again?

practice.en: How do you spell your name?

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly classmate on the first day of a weekend English conversation class in Seoul. Greet the learner, ask their name, and if the name sounds long, ask what you should call them.
roleplay.scene_ko: 주말 영어 회화 수업 첫날, 옆자리에 앉은 사람이 먼저 인사를 건네요.
roleplay.opener: Hi there! I'm Olivia. Nice to meet you.

missions.en: Return Olivia's greeting
Tell Olivia your name

missions.ko: 불러 줬으면 하는 이름 알려 주기
missions.en: Tell Olivia what she can call you

useful.en: Nice to meet you, too.
Hi, my name is Jisoo.
You can call me Jay.
Sorry, what's your name again?

lessons.title: 출신과 사는 곳 말하기
lessons.goal_ko: 어디서 왔는지, 지금 어디에 사는지 묻고 답할 수 있어요.

learn.en: I'm from Daegu, Korea.
learn.note_ko: 출신을 말할 때 써요. 도시와 나라를 함께 말할 땐 '도시, 나라' 순서예요.

learn.en: I live in Incheon now.
learn.note_ko: 사는 곳은 live in 뒤에 넣어요. 끝에 now를 붙이면 '지금은'이라는 뜻이 더해져요.

learn.en: Where are you from?
learn.note_ko: 출신을 묻는 기본 질문이에요. 내가 답한 뒤 'What about you?'로 되물어도 돼요.

practice.en: I'm from Daegu, Korea.
alts: I am from Daegu, Korea.

practice.en: I live in Incheon now.
Where are you from?
I'm from Jeju Island.
alts: I am from Jeju Island.

practice.en: I live in Suwon now.
Where do you live now?
alts: Where are you living now?

practice.en: I'm from Gwangju, Korea.
alts: I am from Gwangju, Korea.

practice.en: My hometown is a small city.
I live downtown, near the station.
practice.ko: 저는 시내 쪽, 역 근처에 살아요.
alts: I live downtown near the station.

practice.en: I live in a quiet neighborhood.
Which country are you from?
alts: What country are you from?

practice.en: I'm from Seoul, but I live in Busan now.
alts: I am from Seoul, but I live in Busan now.
I'm from Seoul, but now I live in Busan.

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly traveler from Canada sitting at a guesthouse breakfast table in Jeonju. Chat casually. Do not say where you are from until the learner asks. Ask where the learner is from and where they live now.
roleplay.scene_ko: 전주의 한 게스트하우스, 아침 식탁에서 여행자와 마주 앉았어요.
roleplay.opener: Good morning! I'm Ethan. Are you visiting Jeonju too?
roleplay.opener_ko: 좋은 아침이에요! 저는 이선이에요. 전주에 여행 오셨어요?

missions.en: Tell Ethan where you're from
Tell Ethan where you live now
Ask Ethan where he's from

useful.en: I'm from Daegu, Korea.
I live in Incheon now.
Where are you from?
What about you, Ethan?

lessons.title: 하는 일 묻고 답하기
lessons.goal_ko: 내가 하는 일이나 공부를 말하고, 상대의 일도 물어볼 수 있어요.

learn.en: What do you do for work?
learn.note_ko: 직업을 묻는 자연스러운 말이에요. 'What's your job?'보다 부드럽게 들려요.

learn.en: I work at a design company.
learn.note_ko: 일하는 곳은 at 뒤에 넣어요. 회사, 병원, 가게 모두 이렇게 말해요.

learn.en: I'm a college student.
learn.note_ko: 직업이나 신분 앞에는 a를 붙여요. 모음 소리로 시작하면 'an engineer'처럼 an을 써요.

practice.en: What do you do for work?
I work at a design company.
I'm a college student.
alts: I am a college student.

practice.en: I work at a hospital.
I'm a software engineer.
alts: I am a software engineer.

practice.en: I'm an office worker.
alts: I am an office worker.
I work in an office.

practice.en: I work at a game company.
I'm a nurse at a big hospital.
alts: I am a nurse at a big hospital.

practice.en: What's your major in college?
alts: What is your major in college?
What do you study in college?

practice.en: My major is business.
alts: I major in business.

practice.en: I work part-time at a cafe.
alts: I have a part-time job at a cafe.

practice.en: I'm retired, but I teach piano sometimes.
alts: I am retired, but I teach piano sometimes.
I'm retired, but I sometimes teach piano.

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly member of a weekend running club in Seoul, chatting with a newer member during a break. You are a high school science teacher. Do not mention your job until the learner asks. Ask about the learner's work or studies too.
roleplay.scene_ko: 주말 달리기 모임에서 쉬는 시간에 옆 사람이 말을 걸어요.
roleplay.opener: That was a great run! I'm Grace, by the way. Are you new to the club?
roleplay.opener_ko: 오늘 잘 뛰었네요! 참, 저는 그레이스예요. 모임에 새로 오셨어요?

missions.en: Ask Grace what she does for work
Tell Grace where you work or study
Tell Grace your job or that you're a student

useful.en: What do you do for work?
I work at a design company.
I'm a college student.
How about you, Grace?

lessons.title: 카페에서 음료 주문하기
lessons.goal_ko: 카페에서 음료를 사이즈와 옵션까지 말해 주문할 수 있어요.

learn.en: Can I get an iced latte?
learn.note_ko: 주문할 때 가장 많이 쓰는 말이에요. 끝에 please를 붙이면 더 공손해요.

learn.en: A large one, please.
learn.note_ko: 사이즈를 물으면 이렇게 답해요. one은 앞에서 말한 음료를 가리켜요.

learn.en: With oat milk, please.
learn.note_ko: 우유나 시럽 같은 옵션을 말할 때 써요. 빼 달라고 할 땐 with 대신 without을 써요.

practice.en: Can I get an iced latte?
A large one, please.
With oat milk, please.
Can I get a hot tea?
A medium one, please.
With soy milk, please.
Can I get an iced green tea?
Can I get a decaf latte, please?
alts: Can I have a decaf latte, please?
Could I get a decaf latte, please?

practice.en: With an extra shot, please.
alts: Add an extra shot, please.
Can I get an extra shot?

practice.en: No whipped cream, please.
alts: Without whipped cream, please.
Hold the whipped cream, please.

practice.en: A small iced coffee, please.
alts: Can I get a small iced coffee?

practice.en: Can I get two medium hot chocolates?
practice.ko: 핫초코 중간 사이즈로 두 잔 주세요.
alts: Can I have two medium hot chocolates?
Could I get two medium hot chocolates?

roleplay.ai_role: a cheerful barista at a small neighborhood cafe called Pebble Cafe in Toronto. Take the drink order, ask what size the customer wants, and ask if they want any changes such as the milk or an extra shot.
roleplay.scene_ko: 캐나다 여행 중, 동네 작은 카페 '페블 카페'에서 주문할 차례예요.
roleplay.opener: Hi, welcome to Pebble Cafe! What can I get for you today?
roleplay.opener_ko: 안녕하세요, 페블 카페예요! 오늘은 뭐 드릴까요?

missions.en: Order the drink you want
Tell Leo the size you want

missions.ko: 우유나 샷 같은 옵션 하나 바꿔 달라고 하기
missions.en: Ask for one change, like the milk or an extra shot

useful.en: Can I get an iced latte?
A large one, please.
With oat milk, please.
That's all, thank you.

lessons.title: 음식 주문하고 부탁하기
lessons.goal_ko: 식당에서 음식을 주문하고, 맛을 조절하거나 더 달라고 부탁할 수 있어요.

learn.en: I'd like the kimchi fried rice.
learn.note_ko: 메뉴를 고를 때 'I want'보다 공손한 말이에요. I'd는 I would를 줄인 말이에요.

learn.en: Can you make it less spicy?
learn.ko: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요?
learn.note_ko: 맛을 조절해 달라고 할 때 써요. less 뒤에 줄이고 싶은 맛을 넣으면 돼요.

learn.en: Could we get some more water?
learn.note_ko: 더 달라고 할 때 써요. 혼자 왔으면 we 대신 I를 써요.

practice.en: I'd like the kimchi fried rice.
alts: I would like the kimchi fried rice.

practice.en: Can you make it less spicy?
practice.ko: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요?

practice.en: Could we get some more water?
I'd like the beef stew.
alts: I would like the beef stew.

practice.en: Can you make it less salty?
practice.ko: 덜 짜게 해 주실 수 있어요?

practice.en: Could we get some more napkins?
Not too spicy, please.
alts: Please don't make it too spicy.

practice.en: I'd like the grilled fish set.
alts: I would like the grilled fish set.

practice.en: Could we get some more side dishes?
What do you recommend here?
alts: What would you recommend?
What do you recommend?

practice.en: Can I see the menu again?
alts: Could I see the menu again?

practice.en: Could you make it without onions?
practice.ko: 양파는 빼고 해 주실 수 있어요?
alts: Can you make it without onions?

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly server at a small Korean restaurant called Dalbit Kitchen in Los Angeles. Take the order. After the learner orders, mention that the dish is quite spicy. Later, bring the food. Do not offer more water or anything else unless the learner asks.
roleplay.scene_ko: 미국 여행 중, 작은 한식당 '달빛 키친'에서 친구와 저녁을 주문해요.
roleplay.opener: Hi, welcome to Dalbit Kitchen! Are you ready to order?

missions.en: Order one dish you want
Ask Nora to make it less spicy
Ask Nora for more water

useful.en: I'd like the kimchi fried rice.
Can you make it less spicy?
useful.ko: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요?

useful.en: Could we get some more water?
What do you recommend here?

lessons.title: 계산하고 포장하기
lessons.goal_ko: 계산서를 달라고 하고, 결제 방법을 묻고, 남은 음식을 포장해 갈 수 있어요.

learn.en: Can I get the check, please?
learn.note_ko: 미국 식당에서는 보통 자리에서 계산해요. check는 계산서예요.

learn.en: Can I pay by card?
learn.note_ko: 결제 방법을 물을 때 써요. 카드는 by card, 현금은 in cash라고 해요.

learn.en: Could you wrap this up for me?
learn.note_ko: 먹다 남은 음식을 싸 달라고 할 때 써요. 처음부터 포장 주문이면 'to go'라고 해요.

practice.en: Can I get the check, please?
Can I pay by card?
Could you wrap this up for me?
Can I get a receipt, please?
Can I pay in cash?
Can I get a to-go box, please?
Can I get this to go?
alts: Can I get this to go, please?
Can I take this to go?

practice.en: Can I pay with my phone?
Can we split the check?
alts: Can we split the bill?

practice.en: Could you wrap up the leftovers?
alts: Could you wrap the leftovers up for me?
Can you wrap up the leftovers?

practice.en: How much is it altogether?
alts: How much is it all together?
How much is everything?

practice.en: Here's my card, thank you.
alts: Here is my card, thank you.
Here's my card, thanks.

roleplay.ai_role: a polite server at a casual dumpling restaurant in New York. The learner has finished eating and has a few dumplings left. Do not bring the check, mention payment, or offer a to-go box until the learner asks. The total is thirty-eight dollars. You take both cards and cash.
roleplay.scene_ko: 뉴욕 여행 중, 만두집에서 식사를 마쳤어요. 만두가 몇 개 남았네요.
roleplay.opener: How was everything? Can I get you anything else?
roleplay.opener_ko: 식사는 어떠셨어요? 더 필요한 거 있으세요?

missions.en: Ask Marcus for the check
Ask if you can pay by card
Ask Marcus to wrap up the leftover dumplings

useful.en: Can I get the check, please?
Can I pay by card?
Could you wrap this up for me?
How much is it altogether?

lessons.title: 위치 묻고 길 찾기
lessons.goal_ko: 가고 싶은 곳이 어디 있는지 묻고, 간단한 길 안내를 알아들을 수 있어요.

learn.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?
learn.note_ko: 모르는 사람에게 물을 땐 Excuse me로 먼저 말을 걸어요. where's는 where is예요.

learn.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
learn.note_ko: 가까운 곳에 있는지 물을 때 써요. near here 대신 around here라고 해도 돼요.

learn.en: How do I get to City Hall?
learn.note_ko: 가는 방법을 묻는 기본 표현이에요. 걸어서든 차로든 똑같이 써요.

practice.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?
alts: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

practice.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
How do I get to City Hall?
Excuse me, where's the elevator?
alts: Excuse me, where is the elevator?

practice.en: Is there a bank near here?
How do I get to the museum?
Do I go straight for two blocks?
alts: Should I go straight for two blocks?

practice.en: Is there a convenience store near here?
Do I turn left at the corner?
alts: Should I turn left at the corner?

practice.en: Excuse me, where's the main entrance?
alts: Excuse me, where is the main entrance?

practice.en: Is it across from the post office?
Is it far from here?
alts: Is it a long way from here?

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly staff member at the information desk of a large train station in an American city. Answer only the question asked, one at a time, and do not offer other directions. Give short, simple directions using words like straight, left, right, corner, and across from. The restroom is down the hall on the left. There is a pharmacy across from the main entrance. City Hall is a ten-minute walk: go straight for two blocks and turn left.
roleplay.scene_ko: 미국 여행 중, 큰 기차역의 안내 데스크에 왔어요.
roleplay.opener: Hi there! Welcome to the information desk. How can I help you?

missions.ko: 역 안 화장실이 어디 있는지 묻기
missions.en: Ask where the restroom is
Ask if there's a pharmacy near the station
Ask how to get to City Hall

useful.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?
Is there a pharmacy near here?
How do I get to City Hall?
Could you say that again, please?

lessons.title: 지하철과 버스 타기
lessons.goal_ko: 어느 노선을 타고, 어디서 갈아타거나 내리는지 물어볼 수 있어요.

learn.en: Which line goes to Gangnam?
learn.note_ko: 지하철 노선은 line이라고 해요. 버스라면 'Which bus goes to'로 바꿔 말해요.

learn.en: Does this bus stop at Seoul Station?
learn.note_ko: 타기 전에 확인할 때 써요. 지하철이면 bus 대신 train을 넣어요.

learn.en: Where should I get off?
learn.note_ko: get off는 내리다, get on은 타다예요. 그 자리에 transfer를 넣으면 갈아탈 곳을 물어요.

practice.en: Which line goes to Gangnam?
Does this bus stop at Seoul Station?
Where should I get off?
Which line goes to Hongdae?
Does this bus stop at City Hall?
Where should I transfer?
Should I get off at the next stop?
alts: Do I get off at the next stop?

practice.en: Which line goes to the airport?
Should I take exit number three?
alts: Should I take exit three?
Do I take exit number three?

practice.en: Which platform should I go to?
alts: Which platform do I go to?

practice.en: Where should I tap my transit card?
Does this train go to Suwon?
alts: Is this train going to Suwon?

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly staff member at a subway station in a big American city. The learner wants to go to the Art Museum. Answer only what is asked, one step at a time. If asked which line, say the Green Line. Mention the transfer to the Blue Line at Central Station only when asked where to transfer. Confirm that the Blue Line stops at Museum Street, the station for the museum, only when asked. Keep answers clear and simple.
roleplay.scene_ko: 미국 여행 중, 지하철역에서 미술관에 가는 길을 역무원에게 물어요.
roleplay.opener: Hi there! You look a little lost. Where are you headed?
roleplay.opener_ko: 안녕하세요! 길을 찾으시는 것 같네요. 어디 가세요?

missions.en: Ask which line goes to the Art Museum
Ask where you should transfer

missions.ko: 갈아탈 열차가 뮤지엄 스트리트역에 서는지 확인하기
missions.en: Check that the next train stops at Museum Street

useful.en: Which line goes to the Art Museum?
Where should I transfer?
Does this train stop at Museum Street?
Thanks, that really helps.

lessons.title: 택시에서 목적지 말하기
lessons.goal_ko: 택시 기사에게 목적지와 내릴 곳을 말하고, 걸리는 시간을 물을 수 있어요.

learn.en: Can you take me to the airport?
learn.note_ko: 택시에서 목적지를 말할 때 써요. 주소를 보여 줄 땐 'this address'라고 해요.

learn.en: How long will it take?
learn.note_ko: 걸리는 시간을 묻는 말이에요. 'About twenty minutes.'처럼 답이 와요.

learn.en: You can drop me off here.
learn.note_ko: 내리고 싶은 곳을 말할 때 써요. here 자리에 at the corner처럼 장소를 넣어요.

practice.en: Can you take me to the airport?
How long will it take?
You can drop me off here.
Can you take me to Seoul Station?
You can drop me off at the corner.
Can you take me to this address?
Is there a lot of traffic now?
alts: Is traffic bad right now?
Is there much traffic now?

practice.en: You can drop me off in front of the bank.
Please stop at the next traffic light.
alts: Could you stop at the next traffic light?
Can you stop at the next traffic light?

practice.en: Could you open the trunk, please?
alts: Can you open the trunk, please?

practice.en: I'm in a bit of a hurry.
alts: I am in a bit of a hurry.

practice.en: How long will it take to get there?
alts: How long does it take to get there?

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly taxi driver in a big American city, picking up the learner at the airport. The learner is going to the Maple Bay Hotel. With today's traffic, the ride takes about twenty-five minutes, but do not mention the time unless the learner asks. When you arrive, ask where exactly they want to get out.
roleplay.scene_ko: 미국 여행 첫날, 공항 앞에서 택시를 탔어요.
roleplay.opener: Hi there, welcome! Where can I take you today?
roleplay.opener_ko: 안녕하세요, 어서 오세요! 오늘 어디로 모실까요?

missions.ko: 메이플 베이 호텔로 가 달라고 하기
missions.en: Ask Rachel to take you to the Maple Bay Hotel
Ask how long the ride will take

missions.ko: 호텔 정문 앞에서 내려 달라고 하기
missions.en: Ask Rachel to drop you off at the hotel's main entrance

useful.en: Can you take me to the Maple Bay Hotel?
How long will it take?
You can drop me off here.
Here's the address on my phone.

courses.title: 여행·일상 회화
courses.desc_ko: 공항·호텔·회사에서 바로 쓰는 표현과 내 생각을 말하는 법을 익혀요.

lessons.title: 공항 체크인과 탑승
lessons.goal_ko: 공항 카운터에서 체크인하고, 원하는 좌석을 부탁하고, 탑승구를 물어볼 수 있어요.

learn.en: I'd like to check in for my flight to Tokyo.
learn.note_ko: 'I'd like to ~'는 '~하고 싶어요'를 정중하게 말하는 틀이에요. 카운터에서 첫마디로 좋아요.

learn.en: Could I get an aisle seat, please?
learn.ko: 통로 쪽 좌석으로 받을 수 있을까요?
learn.note_ko: 'Could I get ~?'은 무언가를 달라고 정중하게 부탁할 때 써요. 창가 자리는 window seat예요.

learn.en: Which gate does my flight leave from?
learn.ko: 제 비행기는 몇 번 탑승구에서 출발해요?
learn.note_ko: 탑승구를 물을 때 써요. 'leave from'은 '~에서 출발하다'라는 뜻이에요.

practice.en: I'd like to check in for my flight to Tokyo.
Could I get an aisle seat, please?
practice.ko: 통로 쪽 좌석으로 받을 수 있을까요?

practice.en: Which gate does my flight leave from?
practice.ko: 제 비행기는 몇 번 탑승구에서 출발해요?

practice.en: I'd like to check in for my flight to Bangkok.
alts: I would like to check in for my flight to Bangkok.

practice.en: Could I get a window seat, please?
alts: Can I get a window seat, please?

practice.en: Which gate does the flight to Osaka leave from?
practice.ko: 오사카행 비행기는 몇 번 탑승구에서 출발해요?

practice.en: I'd like to check just one bag today.
alts: I would like to check just one bag today.

practice.en: Could I get a seat closer to the front, please?
practice.ko: 좀 더 앞쪽 자리로 받을 수 있을까요?
alts: Can I get a seat closer to the front, please?

practice.en: Can I bring this carry-on bag on the plane?
practice.ko: 이 기내용 가방 비행기에 들고 타도 돼요?
alts: Can I take this carry-on bag on the plane?

practice.en: Could I get my boarding pass on my phone, please?
alts: Can I get my boarding pass on my phone, please?

practice.en: Here's my passport, and I'd like an aisle seat.
practice.ko: 여기 여권이요. 통로 쪽 자리로 주세요.
alts: Here is my passport, and I would like an aisle seat.

practice.en: What time does boarding start at gate twelve?
alts: When does boarding start at gate twelve?

roleplay.ai_role: a polite check-in agent at an airline counter in an international airport, helping a passenger check in for a flight to Tokyo; ask about seats and bags, and answer questions about the gate
roleplay.scene_ko: 공항 항공사 카운터에서 도쿄행 비행기 체크인을 해요.
roleplay.opener: Good morning! Where are you flying to today?

missions.en: Say you'd like to check in and tell Daniel where you're flying
Ask for the kind of seat you want
Ask which gate your flight leaves from

useful.en: I'd like to check in for my flight to Tokyo.
Could I get an aisle seat, please?
useful.ko: 통로 쪽 좌석으로 받을 수 있을까요?

useful.en: Which gate does my flight leave from?
useful.ko: 제 비행기는 몇 번 탑승구에서 출발해요?

useful.en: Here's my passport and my booking number.

lessons.title: 호텔 체크인과 요청
lessons.goal_ko: 호텔에서 예약을 확인하고, 되는지 묻고, 필요한 것을 부탁할 수 있어요.

learn.en: I have a reservation under the name Kim.
learn.note_ko: 'under the name ~'은 '~ 이름으로'라는 뜻이에요. 성만 말해도 돼요.
learn.pattern: I have a reservation under the name ___.

learn.en: Is it possible to check in a little early?
learn.note_ko: 'Is it possible to ~?'는 되는지 조심스럽게 물을 때 써요. 늦은 체크아웃은 check out late예요.

learn.en: Could you send up some extra towels, please?
learn.ko: 수건 좀 더 올려 보내 주시겠어요?
learn.note_ko: 'Could you ~?'는 상대에게 해 달라고 부탁하는 틀이에요. send up은 방으로 올려 보내는 거예요.

practice.en: I have a reservation under the name Kim.
Is it possible to check in a little early?
Could you send up some extra towels, please?
practice.ko: 수건 좀 더 올려 보내 주시겠어요?

practice.en: I have a reservation under the name Park.
practice.pattern: I have a reservation under the name ___.
alts: I've got a reservation under the name Park.

practice.en: Is it possible to check out late tomorrow?
alts: Would it be possible to check out late tomorrow?

practice.en: Could you bring us two more towels, please?
alts: Can you bring us two more towels, please?

practice.en: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?
alts: Can you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?

practice.en: Is it possible to leave my bags at the front desk?
practice.ko: 프런트에 짐을 맡겨 둘 수 있을까요?
alts: Would it be possible to leave my bags at the front desk?

practice.en: My room key isn't working. Could you check it, please?
practice.ko: 방 열쇠가 안 돼요. 확인 좀 해 주시겠어요?
alts: My room key is not working. Could you check it, please?

practice.en: Could you give me a wake-up call at seven, please?
alts: Can you give me a wake-up call at seven, please?

practice.en: Is it possible to get a room on a higher floor?
practice.ko: 더 높은 층 방으로 받을 수 있을까요?
alts: Would it be possible to get a room on a higher floor?

practice.en: I have a reservation for three nights, and I'd like a quiet room.
alts: I have a reservation for three nights, and I would like a quiet room.

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly front desk clerk at a small hotel in San Francisco, checking in a guest who arrived early in the morning before the usual check-in time; the room may be ready soon, and you are happy to help with requests
roleplay.scene_ko: 아침 일찍 호텔에 도착했어요. 프런트 직원이 맞아 줘요.
roleplay.opener: Good morning, and welcome! How can I help you today?
roleplay.opener_ko: 좋은 아침이에요, 어서 오세요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

missions.en: Tell Grace the name on your reservation
Ask if it's possible to check in early
Ask her to send something up to your room

useful.en: I have a reservation under the name Kim.
Is it possible to check in a little early?
Could you send up some extra towels, please?
useful.ko: 수건 좀 더 올려 보내 주시겠어요?

useful.en: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?

lessons.title: 분실·지연 문제 해결
lessons.goal_ko: 물건을 잃어버리거나 비행기가 늦었을 때 상황을 설명하고 도움을 청할 수 있어요.

learn.en: I think I left my phone on the bus.
learn.ko: 버스에 휴대폰을 두고 내린 것 같아요.
learn.note_ko: 'I think I left ~'는 어딘가에 두고 온 것 같을 때 써요. 확실하지 않으면 I think를 붙여요.

learn.en: My flight was delayed, so I missed my connection.
learn.note_ko: '~, so ~'로 원인과 결과를 한 번에 말해요. connection은 갈아탈 비행기예요.
learn.pattern: My flight was delayed, so I ___.

learn.en: Can you let me know when you find it?
learn.note_ko: 'let me know'는 '알려 주세요'라는 뜻이에요. 연락처를 같이 남기면 좋아요.
learn.pattern: Can you let me know when ___?

practice.en: I think I left my phone on the bus.
practice.ko: 버스에 휴대폰을 두고 내린 것 같아요.

practice.en: My flight was delayed, so I missed my connection.
Can you let me know when you find it?
I think I left my wallet in the taxi.
practice.ko: 택시에 지갑을 두고 내린 것 같아요.

practice.en: My flight was delayed, so I missed the last train.
practice.pattern: My flight was delayed, so I ___.

practice.en: Can you let me know when my suitcase arrives?
practice.ko: 제 가방이 도착하면 알려 주실 수 있어요?
practice.pattern: Can you let me know when ___?
alts: Could you let me know when my suitcase arrives?

practice.en: I think I left my sunglasses on the plane.
practice.ko: 비행기에 선글라스를 두고 내린 것 같아요.

practice.en: My flight was delayed, so I need a new hotel for tonight.
practice.ko: 비행기가 늦어서 오늘 밤 묵을 호텔이 새로 필요해요.

practice.en: Can you let me know when it shows up at lost and found?
practice.ko: 분실물 센터에 들어오면 알려 주실 수 있어요?
alts: Could you let me know when it shows up at lost and found?

practice.en: My suitcase didn't come out at baggage claim, so I need help.
practice.ko: 수하물 찾는 곳에서 가방이 안 나와서 도움이 필요해요.
alts: My suitcase did not come out at baggage claim, so I need help.

practice.en: The train was delayed, so I'm going to be about an hour late.
practice.ko: 기차가 늦어져서 한 시간쯤 늦을 것 같아요.
alts: The train was delayed, so I'll be about an hour late.

practice.en: My connection was canceled, so can you book me on the next flight?
practice.ko: 연결편이 취소됐는데, 다음 비행기로 예약해 주실 수 있어요?
alts: My connection was canceled, so could you book me on the next flight?

roleplay.ai_role: a calm and helpful airport service desk agent in Chicago who helps travelers with missed connections and items left on the plane; ask what happened, what was lost, and how to contact them
roleplay.scene_ko: 비행기가 늦게 도착해 갈아탈 비행기를 놓쳤어요. 게다가 기내에 물건까지 두고 내렸어요.
roleplay.opener: Hi there, you look a little stressed. What happened?
roleplay.opener_ko: 안녕하세요, 좀 당황하신 것 같네요. 무슨 일이세요?

missions.en: Explain that your flight was delayed and you missed your connection

missions.ko: 기내에 두고 내린 것 같은 물건 말하기
missions.en: Say what you think you left on the plane
Ask Priya to let you know when they find it

useful.en: I think I left my phone on the bus.
useful.ko: 버스에 휴대폰을 두고 내린 것 같아요.

useful.en: My flight was delayed, so I missed my connection.
Can you let me know when you find it?
Is there a later flight I can take today?
useful.ko: 오늘 탈 수 있는 더 늦은 비행기가 있어요?

lessons.title: 회의 일정 잡기
lessons.goal_ko: 동료에게 회의 시간을 제안하고, 괜찮은지 묻고, 일정을 미룰 수 있어요.

learn.en: Are you free for a quick meeting on Thursday?
learn.note_ko: 'Are you free ~?'는 시간이 되는지 묻는 가장 흔한 말이에요. 요일 앞에는 on을 써요.

learn.en: How does ten thirty work for you?
learn.note_ko: 'How does ~ work for you?'는 시간을 제안하면서 상대 사정을 묻는 말이에요.

learn.en: Can we push the meeting back to next week?
learn.ko: 회의를 다음 주로 미룰 수 있을까요?
learn.note_ko: 'push back'은 일정을 뒤로 미루는 거예요. 앞당길 때는 move up을 써요.
learn.pattern: Can we push the meeting back to ___?

practice.en: Are you free for a quick meeting on Thursday?
How does ten thirty work for you?
Can we push the meeting back to next week?
practice.ko: 회의를 다음 주로 미룰 수 있을까요?

practice.en: Are you free for a call tomorrow afternoon?
How does two o'clock work for you?
alts: How does two work for you?

practice.en: Can we push the meeting back to Friday?
practice.pattern: Can we push the meeting back to ___?
alts: Could we push the meeting back to Friday?

practice.en: Are you available for a video call this afternoon?
alts: Are you free for a video call this afternoon?

practice.en: How does Monday morning work for you?
Are you free to meet in the conference room at three?
alts: Can we meet in the conference room at three?

practice.en: I need to reschedule. Can we push it back to Wednesday?
practice.ko: 일정을 다시 잡아야 해요. 수요일로 미룰 수 있을까요?
alts: I need to reschedule. Could we push it back to Wednesday?

practice.en: How does next Tuesday work for you? I'll send a calendar invite.
practice.ko: 다음 주 화요일 괜찮으세요? 일정 초대 보내 드릴게요.
alts: How does next Tuesday work for you? I will send a calendar invite.

practice.en: Can we push the meeting back an hour? The agenda isn't ready yet.
practice.ko: 회의를 한 시간 미룰 수 있을까요? 안건이 아직 준비가 안 됐어요.
alts: Can we push the meeting back an hour? The agenda is not ready yet.

roleplay.ai_role: a friendly coworker at a design company who needs to meet with the user about a new project this week; your schedule is busy, so check times carefully and be open if the user suggests moving the meeting to another day
roleplay.scene_ko: 새 프로젝트 때문에 동료 마커스와 이번 주 회의 시간을 정해야 해요.
roleplay.opener: Hey, you wanted to talk about the new project, right?
roleplay.opener_ko: 안녕하세요, 새 프로젝트 얘기하고 싶다고 하셨죠?

missions.en: Ask if Marcus is free for a meeting
Suggest a specific time and ask if it works for him
Ask to push the meeting back to another day

useful.en: Are you free for a quick meeting on Thursday?
How does ten thirty work for you?
Can we push the meeting back to next week?
useful.ko: 회의를 다음 주로 미룰 수 있을까요?

useful.en: I'll send you a calendar invite.

lessons.title: 정중하게 부탁하기
lessons.goal_ko: 동료에게 도움이 필요할 때 부담 주지 않고 정중하게 부탁할 수 있어요.

learn.en: Would you mind looking over my report?
learn.ko: 제 보고서 좀 봐 주실 수 있어요?
learn.note_ko: 'Would you mind ~ing?'는 아주 정중한 부탁이에요. 괜찮다는 대답은 'Not at all.'이에요.

learn.en: Could you send me the file when you get a chance?
learn.ko: 시간 날 때 그 파일 좀 보내 주실래요?
learn.note_ko: 'when you get a chance'를 붙이면 급하지 않다는 느낌이 들어 더 부드러워요.
learn.pattern: Could you ___ when you get a chance?

learn.en: I was wondering if you could help me with this.
learn.ko: 이것 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.
learn.note_ko: 'I was wondering if ~'는 조심스럽게 부탁을 꺼낼 때 써요. 윗사람에게도 좋아요.
learn.pattern: I was wondering if you could ___.

practice.en: Would you mind looking over my report?
practice.ko: 제 보고서 좀 봐 주실 수 있어요?

practice.en: Could you send me the file when you get a chance?
practice.ko: 시간 날 때 그 파일 좀 보내 주실래요?

practice.en: I was wondering if you could help me with this.
practice.ko: 이것 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

practice.en: Would you mind closing the window a little?
Could you call me back when you get a chance?
practice.ko: 시간 날 때 다시 전화 주실래요?
practice.pattern: Could you ___ when you get a chance?
alts: Can you call me back when you get a chance?

practice.en: I was wondering if you could check my slides.
practice.ko: 제 발표 자료 좀 확인해 주실 수 있을까 해서요.
practice.pattern: I was wondering if you could ___.

practice.en: Would you mind giving me some feedback on this?
practice.ko: 이거 의견 좀 주실 수 있어요?

practice.en: Could you update the spreadsheet when you get a chance?
practice.ko: 시간 날 때 스프레드시트 좀 업데이트해 주실래요?
alts: Can you update the spreadsheet when you get a chance?

practice.en: Would you mind if I left a little early today?
practice.ko: 오늘 제가 조금 일찍 나가도 괜찮을까요?
alts: Would you mind if I leave a little early today?

practice.en: I was wondering if you could cover the client call for me.
practice.ko: 저 대신 고객 통화 좀 맡아 주실 수 있을까 해서요.

practice.en: Could you look over my report before the deadline on Friday?
practice.ko: 금요일 마감 전에 제 보고서 좀 봐 주실래요?
alts: Can you look over my report before the deadline on Friday?

practice.en: I was wondering if we could move the deadline to next Monday.
practice.ko: 마감을 다음 주 월요일로 옮길 수 있을까 해서요.

roleplay.ai_role: a kind and experienced coworker on the marketing team who is busy today but happy to help when asked politely; you have a template file from last year's presentation that could be useful
roleplay.scene_ko: 내일 발표가 있는데 자료가 걱정돼요. 경험 많은 옆자리 동료에게 부탁해 봐요.
roleplay.opener: Hey, you look busy. Is everything going okay?
roleplay.opener_ko: 어, 바빠 보이네요. 일은 잘되고 있어요?

missions.en: Politely bring up that you need some help

missions.ko: 발표 자료를 봐 줄 수 있는지 부탁하기
missions.en: Ask Olivia if she would mind looking over your slides

missions.ko: 시간 날 때 파일을 보내 달라고 하기
missions.en: Ask her to send you a file when she gets a chance

useful.en: Would you mind looking over my report?
useful.ko: 제 보고서 좀 봐 주실 수 있어요?

useful.en: Could you send me the file when you get a chance?
useful.ko: 시간 날 때 그 파일 좀 보내 주실래요?

useful.en: I was wondering if you could help me with this.
useful.ko: 이것 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

useful.en: Thanks so much, I really appreciate it.

lessons.title: 동료와 주말 이야기
lessons.goal_ko: 월요일에 동료와 주말에 한 일을 묻고 답하며 가볍게 이야기할 수 있어요.

learn.en: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
learn.ko: 주말 어땠어요? 뭐 재미있는 거 했어요?
learn.note_ko: 월요일 아침에 가장 흔한 인사예요. 질문 두 개를 이어서 대화를 열어요.

learn.en: I went hiking with my family on Saturday.
learn.note_ko: 'went ~ing'로 주말에 한 활동을 말해요. went camping, went shopping처럼 써요.

learn.en: Not much, I just stayed home and relaxed.
learn.note_ko: 특별한 일이 없었을 때 쓰는 대답이에요. 'Not much'로 시작하면 자연스러워요.

practice.en: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
practice.ko: 주말 어땠어요? 뭐 재미있는 거 했어요?

practice.en: I went hiking with my family on Saturday.
Not much, I just stayed home and relaxed.
I went camping by the lake on Saturday.
Not much, I just needed to catch up on sleep.
practice.ko: 별거 없었어요, 그냥 밀린 잠을 좀 자야 했어요.

practice.en: I went to a farmers market on Saturday.
How was your trip to Busan? Did you eat anything good?
practice.ko: 부산 여행 어땠어요? 맛있는 거 먹었어요?

practice.en: Not much, I just cleaned the house and did laundry.
practice.ko: 별거 없었어요, 그냥 집 청소하고 빨래했어요.

practice.en: I went to see a movie with my cousin on Sunday.
Not much, I just wanted to relax after a long week.
practice.ko: 별거 없었어요. 한 주 내내 바빠서 그냥 쉬고 싶었어요.

practice.en: How was your weekend? Did you go hiking again?
I went hiking on Saturday. Do you have any plans for next weekend?
practice.ko: 토요일에 등산 갔어요. 다음 주말엔 무슨 계획 있어요?
alts: I went hiking on Saturday. Any plans for next weekend?

roleplay.ai_role: a cheerful coworker chatting by the coffee machine on Monday morning; you spent the weekend cooking a big dinner for friends, and you like to ask easy follow-up questions
roleplay.scene_ko: 월요일 아침, 탕비실 커피 머신 앞에서 동료 케빈을 만났어요.
roleplay.opener: Good morning! Did you have a good weekend?

missions.en: Tell Kevin one thing you did over the weekend
Describe a quiet day, starting with 'Not much'
Ask Kevin how his weekend was and if he did anything fun

useful.en: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
useful.ko: 주말 어땠어요? 뭐 재미있는 거 했어요?

useful.en: I went hiking with my family on Saturday.
Not much, I just stayed home and relaxed.
That sounds like fun! Who did you go with?

lessons.title: 의견 말하고 동의·반대하기
lessons.goal_ko: 내 의견을 말하고, 상대 의견에 동의하거나 부드럽게 반대할 수 있어요.

learn.en: In my opinion, working from home saves a lot of time.
learn.ko: 제 생각엔 재택근무가 시간을 많이 아껴 줘요.
learn.note_ko: 'In my opinion'은 내 의견을 꺼낼 때 써요. 가볍게는 'I think'라고 해도 돼요.

learn.en: I totally agree with you on that.
learn.note_ko: 강하게 동의할 때 써요. 어느 정도만 동의하면 'I agree to some extent.'예요.

learn.en: I see your point, but I'm not so sure.

lessons.title: 추천하고 이유 말하기
lessons.goal_ko: 가 볼 만한 곳이나 먹어 볼 만한 것을 추천하고 이유를 말할 수 있어요.

learn.en: You should try the noodle place near the station.
learn.ko: 역 근처 국숫집 한번 가 보세요.
learn.note_ko: 'You should try ~'는 친구에게 무언가를 권할 때 가장 흔한 말이에요.

learn.en: I'd definitely recommend going there in the fall.
learn.ko: 거기는 꼭 가을에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.
learn.note_ko: recommend 뒤에 동사가 오면 ~ing 꼴로 써요. definitely는 '꼭'이라는 느낌이에요.

learn.en: It's worth it because the view is amazing.
learn.note_ko: 'It's worth it'은 돈이나 시간을 쓸 만하다는 뜻이에요. because로 이유를 붙여요.

lessons.title: 해 본 일 이야기하기
lessons.goal_ko: 현재완료로 해 본 적이 있는지 묻고, 내 경험과 횟수를 말할 수 있어요.

learn.en: Have you ever been to a music festival?
learn.ko: 음악 축제에 가 본 적 있어요?
learn.note_ko: 'Have you ever ~?'는 경험을 묻는 틀이에요. been to는 '~에 가 본 적'이에요.

learn.en: I've never tried skiing, but I'd love to.
learn.ko: 스키는 한 번도 안 타 봤는데, 꼭 타 보고 싶어요.
learn.note_ko: 'I've never ~'는 한 번도 안 해 봤다는 말이에요. but I'd love to로 바람을 덧붙여요.
learn.pattern: I've never ___, but I'd love to.

learn.en: I've been to Japan three times, actually.
learn.ko: 사실 일본은 세 번 가 봤어요.
learn.note_ko: 횟수는 once, twice, three times로 말해요. 현재완료는 지금까지의 경험을 말해요.
